## Summary

LibKa0s's glyph catalog is being expanded beyond Open Iconic with two new third-party icon sources:

- **Open Iconic**: completed up to its full 223 marks (MIT, already attributed via `media/icons/LICENSE-open-iconic.txt`)
- **Phosphor Icons**, Fill weight: MIT, https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core
- **Game-icons.net**: **CC BY 3.0**, https://github.com/game-icons/icons. Attribution is a *license requirement*, not a courtesy. Each icon credits its individual author (Lorc, Delapouite, Skoll, etc.).

The first consumer to vendor the expanded set is **Ka0s Quick Comms**. The owner will re-vendor this LibKa0s version into every Ka0s addon later. When that happens, each consumer has to carry the attribution too.

## What to do when re-vendoring to every Ka0s addon (Quick Comms included)

- [ ] **README**: add a Credits / third-party art section naming Open Iconic (MIT), Phosphor Icons (MIT) and Game-icons.net (CC BY 3.0, with the author list and a link to https://game-icons.net). It should sit next to the existing "Bundles LibKa0s" line.
- [ ] **Individual files**: confirm that the vendored `libs/LibKa0s/media/icons/` tree ships every license and attribution file (`LICENSE-open-iconic.txt`, the Phosphor MIT license, the Game-icons CC BY 3.0 license, and a per-icon author attribution list), and that `.pkgmeta` or packaging doesn't strip them.
- [ ] **In-game**: where an addon shows a glyph picker (Quick Comms's icon browser), make the credit reachable, for example a tooltip or footer naming the set and the author for Game-icons glyphs.
- [ ] Record the attribution requirement in LibKa0s `docs/releasing.md` / `docs/api` (Media) so later consumers inherit it.

## Addons

Every Ka0s addon that vendors LibKa0s, including QuickComms.
